title: Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements — Tier Entry Levels and Roster Limits
content:
Every tier of Crestline Corporate Travel Agreements is held against an annual spend threshold and carries its own limits on the size of the traveler roster.

**Schedule clause.** The annual spend threshold of a tier is the eligible Crestline spend per agreement year required to hold that tier, in US dollars. The minimum enrolled travelers of a tier is the number of travelers who must be on the roster at approval. The roster cap is the largest number of travelers on the roster at one time, and the travel arranger limit is the largest number of roster entries that carry the travel arranger role. The four Corporate tiers are entered only with a negotiated contract signed by the company; the two Business Connect tiers are entered without one.

| Tier | Annual spend threshold (USD) | Minimum enrolled travelers | Roster cap (travelers) | Travel arranger limit (persons) | Negotiated contract |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Business Connect | 0 | 2 | 25 | 1 | not required |
| Crestline Business Connect Plus | 25000 | 5 | 100 | 2 | not required |
| Crestline Corporate Select | 150000 | 25 | 500 | 5 | required |
| Crestline Corporate Preferred | 500000 | 75 | 2500 | 10 | required |
| Crestline Corporate Premier | 1500000 | 200 | 10000 | 25 | required |
| Crestline Corporate Strategic | 5000000 | 500 | 50000 | 50 | required |

### Reading the schedule

- A threshold of USD 0 for Crestline Business Connect means that any documented spend, including none, reaches that tier's spend level; the tier still needs 2 travelers on the roster at approval.
- The travel arranger limit counts within the roster cap: travel arrangers are roster entries, so a Crestline Corporate Select roster holds at most 500 travelers at one time, of whom at most 5 carry the travel arranger role.
- The minimum enrolled travelers is measured at approval; the roster cap applies at every moment the roster exists.

### Hypothetical placement

A hypothetical company documents USD 160000 of annual Crestline spend and has 30 travelers on its active roster at approval. It reaches the spend level (150000) and roster level (25) of Crestline Corporate Select, and it does not reach those of Crestline Corporate Preferred (500000 and 75). Entry at Crestline Corporate Select also needs the negotiated contract shown in the last column. The figures are illustrative inputs, not company facts.
